title: Gritty Portrait with Text Overlay
coreRelationships: The human face is the central, dominant element, occupying most of the frame.
High contrast between dark and light areas defines the facial features and creates depth.
The pervasive grain and noise texture unifies the entire image, obscuring fine details.
The overlaid text elements are small and unobtrusive, serving as informational accents rather than primary visual foci.
reuseFormula: Generate a high-contrast, grainy, monochrome portrait of a human face, emphasizing dark tones and abstract features. Overlay small, white, all-caps monospaced text in the top-left and top-right corners for informational purposes.
